tickets.title: Open inheritance intake
tickets.text: Obtain the current estate document package for Nolan Wrenpuddle, including any trust restatements, durable power of attorney, health care directive, attorney summary letter, and updated will. The advisory file contains the 2014 trust and will but not any later restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, or attorney summary letter. Attorney Celia Thimblefern may have prepared a binder after Carla’s death but could not confirm what was finalized.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Resolve IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Resolve the beneficiary inconsistency between Nolan Wrenpuddle’s traditional IRA and Roth IRA at the custodian. The traditional IRA lists Lena and Oscar equally, while the Roth IRA still lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary. Confirm Nolan’s intent for both accounts to pass directly to his children unless a specific reason exists to keep the trust on one account.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Confirm successor trustee sequence and authority evidence
